label: Crexi Scraper
title: Crexi Scraper: Commercial Listings, Cap Rate & Brokers
metaDescription: Scrape Crexi commercial real estate from any search, city or listing link: price, type, size, address, brokers, plus cap rate, NOI and OM status.
intro: Paste a Crexi search, city or listing link and get each commercial property's price, type, size, address and brokers; add details to get the real cap rate, NOI, year built, tenancy, offering-memorandum status, broker of record and phones.
useCases: Screen deals by cap rate and NOI in a market
Build broker contact lists for a property type
Track new commercial listings in target cities

faq.q: Can I use my own Crexi search?
faq.a: Yes. Set your filters on crexi.com (property type, price, cap rate, occupancy, place, for sale or for lease), copy the address and paste it. Every filter in the link is applied.

faq.q: Is there a limit to how many listings I can get?
faq.a: One Crexi search shows at most 100,000 listings; bigger searches are split automatically. You can also set a limit per link, or 0 for everything it matches.

faq.q: Can I get the brokers' emails?
faq.a: Optionally. The actor reads business emails from each brokerage's own public website, limited to the listing's brokers and the firm's general address.

faq.q: Does it cover lease listings too?
faq.a: Yes. For sale and for lease, every Crexi property type: land, retail, office, industrial, multifamily, hospitality and more.

faq.q: Do I need a Crexi account?
faq.a: No. A listing that needs a Crexi login is still delivered and marked, and the run ends successfully.

officialApi: Crexi has no public API for its listings. This actor returns the commercial listings any visitor can see, with Crexi's own fields.
